0.original: Vuyargur has restocking on the agenda.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

1.original: Speak with the Yok Huy supplier at Zirgorteh the Open-armed.

2.original: Deliver the requested items to the Yok Huy supplier.

24.original: Speak with the Yok Huy supplier at Zirgorteh the Open-armed.

48.original: I'm told the restoration workers residing on the mountain are running low on critical materials. We've a mind to replenish a few daily necessities, if you're willing to contribute.

49.original: Our supplier at Warmth has but recently taken inventory. He should be able to give you a more detailed report of what we currently lack.

50.original: The workers tell me our stock of daily necessities is dwindling yet again. I'd like to resupply our stores as soon as possible─with your invaluable aid, of course.

51.original: In light of this, I imagine the supplier at Warmth has already taken inventory. He should be able to inform you of the goods we currently lack.

52.original: With so many restoration workers choosing to dwell here, the demand for living necessities increases by the day... That said, we can barely keep up.

53.original: We're sorely in need of silverware, so I'd like to make that our first priority. I've already prepared the necessary materials─you are free to take more from the crate there, should you require it.

54.original: We're sorely in need of cleaning cloths, so I'd like to make that our first priority. I've already prepared the necessary materials─you are free to take more from the crate there, should you require it.

55.original: We're sorely in need of medicine, so I'd like to make that our first priority. I've already prepared the necessary materials─you are free to take more from the crate there, should you require it.

56.original: The crate appears to be filled to the brim with sundry materials─none of which you require at this time.

59.original: You obtain additional crafting materials from the crate.

62.original: Ah, you're back. The crafting went smoothly, I take it?

63.original: Let's see here... Yes, this is just enough! On behalf of our workers, I offer my thanks.

64.original: Your presence is a gift to us, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, and I am sure Vuyargur is of the same mind. I wager he's just as eager to hear of your efforts, so I'll leave you to report the good news to him.

65.original: Thank you again, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Now, you'd best be off to Vuyargur. Wouldn't want to keep him waiting, would you?

66.original: The restocking went smoothly? Excellent! Many thanks to you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. The journey from the peaks to Worlar's Echo is a lengthy one, which makes replenishing our supplies a rather thorny task...

67.original: Until we are fully self-sufficient, your aid will be vital to us, just as it was today. It is my hope that we can count on you again when next our stores grow scarce.
